title: Observe, Share, or Predict? Disentangling Partner Information in Embodied Multi-Agent Collaboration
abstract: arXiv:2610.16895v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLMs are used as high-level controllers for embodied agents, but it remains unclear whether they support collaborative reasoning, such as anticipating a collaborator's actions in real-time teamwork without dialogue. We ask if observing the partner's state, exchanging object knowledge, and predicting the partner's next action, shape task outcomes and coordination when agents can share percepts but never intentions, plans, or task-level messages, and whether the two agents occupy symmetric roles. Using the Habitat-based PARTNR benchmark, we introduce a Decoupled Partial Observability regime that enforces strictly individual perception, and we augment decentralized zero-shot ReAct planners with Other Agent's State (OAS) observation, object Knowledge Exchange (KE) between co-located agents, and Other Agent's Next Action (OANA) prediction, evaluated on the full 2 x 2 x 2 grid with four planners on 1,000 validation tasks. translated_title: 观察、共享还是预测？解耦具身多智能体协作中的伙伴信息
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）被用作具身智能体的高层控制器，但它们能否支持协作推理（例如在无对话的实时团队合作中预判协作者的行动）仍不清楚。我们探究当智能体只能共享感知信息、而从不共享意图、计划或任务级消息时，观察伙伴状态、交换物体知识以及预测伙伴下一步行动会如何影响任务结果与协调，以及两个智能体是否占据对称角色。基于Habitat的PARTNR基准，我们引入一种解耦部分可观测性机制，强制执行严格的个体感知，并在分散式零样本ReAct规划器中加入其他智能体状态（OAS）观察、共处一地的智能体之间的物体知识交换（KE）以及其他智能体下一步行动（OANA）预测，在完整的2×2×2组合网格上使用四种规划器于1,000个验证任务上进行评估。OAS观察提升……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究基于PARTNR基准，通过2×2×2因子实验系统解耦了具身多智能体协作中观察伙伴状态、交换物体知识与预测伙伴行动这三种伙伴信息机制，发现观察伙伴状态（OAS）即可有效提升无对话实时协作的表现，且两个智能体的角色与收益并不对称。
